settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: IS-Advisor recommends applicable Indian Standards for procurement specifications using hybrid semantic search, a knowledge graph of standard relationships, and an LLM grounded strictly in retrieved evidence.
settings.disconnectedHint: Unable to reach the recommendation service. Check your connection and try again.
